title: Lattice Boltzmann wind tunnel and the FluidX3D bridge
description: 3-D lattice Boltzmann wind tunnel: drag on a sphere against Stokes' law and the Schiller-Naumann correlation, in 32-bit and 16-bit storage of the distributions. 1. Stokes flow (Re ~ 0.06): a sphere of radius 5 cells in a box of 8 radii, the open sides fixed to the analytic Stokes far field (as in the usual LBM validation of this case).
